title: Differential scanning calorimetry, gel permeation chromatography and linear rheology measurements of poly(D,L-lactide) (Aldrich 805734)
question: How consistently do calorimetry, chromatography and rheology characterize this polymer under changing temperature and deformation?
publisher: Bacova, Petra (Universidad de Cádiz); García Laynez, María del Carmen; Vlassopoulos, Dimitris (University of Crete); Molina, Sergio I. (Universidad de Cadiz Campus de Rio San Pedro)
measurement_dates: Rheology performed in summer 2024; DSC/GPC dates remain source-file specific.
variables_and_units: DSC heat flow, GPC and rheology
independent_units: temperature/frequency sweeps within one polymer batch
validation_design: temperature/frequency sweeps within one polymer batch Verify identifiers before allocating groups; the partition is not executed or frozen by this acquisition.
author_preprocessing: Native instrument exports plus text versions; DSC/GPC calibration context and manufacturer certificate supplied. Rheology was not corrected for rheometer compliance.
prior_analysis_and_limits: One polymer batch. Validate across complete temperature/frequency sweeps; compliance artifacts may mimic constitutive effects. Native proprietary formats may need vendor software.
missingness: Native blanks, sentinels, absent records and source quality flags are preserved. No imputation performed by the curator. Exact missingness semantics come from source dictionaries/headers; no universal missing-value rule is imposed.
calibration: Use the retained source calibration files/standards and instrument metadata where provided. Absence of an explicit calibration record is not replaced by an assumed calibration.
